backend/main.mo: Main canister implementing user roles, profiles, expenses, revenue, COGS data, and automatic Internet Identity–based user provisioning with AccessControl integration.
backend/migration.mo: Simple migration stub that preserves nextCategoryId during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files for documentation or build analysis.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS theme definitions with OKLCH color variables and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React application and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root router and authentication gate using Internet Identity and backend role/profile checks, defining page routes with role protection.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component showing an access-denied message for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Application layout with role-filtered navigation, logout, and header/footer structure.
frontend/src/components/KpiCard.tsx: Displays a KPI card with formatted currency or percent values and a configurable icon and style variant.
frontend/src/components/NumericCell.tsx: Renders a table cell showing a number formatted as currency, percent, or plain number.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Shows a form for entering and saving a user's name using a profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/reports/MonthYea: Provides dropdowns to select a specific month and year for reports.
frontend/src/components/reports/MultiMon: Lets users choose a start month/year and shows the computed multi‑month range.
frontend/src/components/reports/YearSele: Simple dropdown for selecting a reporting year.
frontend/src/components/RequireRole.tsx: Checks the caller's role and either renders children or an access‑denied screen.
frontend/src/components/TimeWindowSelect: Dropdown selector for choosing predefined reporting time windows.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEmployeeAuth.ts: Fetches the caller's role and admin status using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains data queries and mutations for user profiles, categories, and other backend entities, with auto‑seeding logic for categories.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserAdmin.ts: Provides React Query hooks for listing users and changing a user's role, invalidating related queries on update.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables for light/dark themes, utility classes, and print-specific styles.
frontend/src/lib/constants/paymentMethod: Exports a fixed list of allowed payment methods and its corresponding type.
frontend/src/lib/reports/dateRanges.ts: Implements helpers to compute date ranges for months, quarters, half-years, full years, and single days, plus formatting utilities.
frontend/src/lib/seed/restaurantCategori: Provides the default restaurant expense categories and seed metadata keys.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function wrapping clsx and tailwind-merge for merging class names.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsItemsTab.tsx: Lists and manages COGS inventory items with vendor associations and add/edit dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsPurchasesTab: Displays and manages COGS purchase records with add/edit dialogs, loading states, and a table of purchases.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSalesTab.tsx: Displays and manages COGS sales records with add/edit dialogs, loading states, and a table of sales.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSummaryTab.t: Shows COGS totals and trends over selectable time ranges with error handling and summary/trend tables.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/utils.ts: Provides helper functions for formatting dates, looking up item/vendor names, and handling YearMonthBucket keys and sorting.
frontend/src/pages/CogsPage.tsx: Displays the COGS section with tabbed navigation for items, purchases, sales, and summary views.
frontend/src/pages/CredentialLoginPage.t: Shows a card informing users that credential-based login is deprecated in favor of Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders financial KPIs, quick stats, and a time‑window selector using dashboard query data.
frontend/src/pages/ExpensesPage.tsx: Loads expenses, categories, vendors, payment methods, and banks, providing a UI for listing and editing expenses.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides the Internet Identity login screen with a sign‑in button and loading state.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Provides tabs and CRUD UI for managing categories, vendors, banks, and payment methods.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Generates filtered financial reports over various date ranges using expenses, revenue, COGS, and master data.
frontend/src/pages/RevenuePage.tsx: Displays and manages revenue records with add/edit dialogs and category selection, gated partly by user role.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Shows user management tools for viewing users and updating their roles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin usage for the project.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s authentication and role‑based access plan using Internet Identity principals with backend‑stored roles and admin UI for managing user roles. Lists existing features and pending feature requests tied to user provisioning, role loading, and admin role management.
